blocks.title: Identify
blocks.text: Identify the separate components of a problem: validation, stock check, updating records and confirming a result.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Determine necessary order from dependencies. Do not send success or deduct stock before validation.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Decompose large operations into subprocedures, each with clear responsibility; update-related steps may need a single transaction to maintain consistency.
